title: AI Deployment Authorisation: A Global Standard for Machine-Readable Governance of High-Risk Artificial Intelligence
reasoning: The paper proposes a comprehensive framework, the AI Deployment Authorisation Score (ADAS), explicitly designed to operationalize and enforce legal, safety, and ethical principles for AI systems. It evaluates dimensions like 'Externality,' which includes discrimination and societal impacts, and 'Alignment' with human goals and regulatory constraints. The core thesis is to create an enforceable, auditable system for ethical governance, making ethics a central and operational component of the work, not just a peripheral discussion.
